name: Notification Center
description: Full notification inbox: filter tabs with counts, Today/Yesterday/This week groups, per-item read, snooze and archive, mark all read, and j/k keyboard triage.

props.name: items
props.description: Notification plus createdAt, category, snoozedUntil?, archived?

props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Receives the next list after any action

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Row click / Enter; item is marked read

usage: Reuses NotificationItem from notifications. Keys: j/k move, Enter open, e archive, u unread, s snooze.
